name: tumpel
description: Tells Claude when a tumpel turn ends, a session goes idle, a host goes offline or a prebuild finishes, through the signed-in tumpel CLI

monitors.name: tenant-events
monitors.command: tumpel events follow --event TurnCompleted --event TurnFailed --event SessionIdle --event HostOffline --event PrebuildDone --event PrebuildFailed
monitors.description: tumpel turns ending, sessions going idle, hosts going offline and prebuilds finishing
